description: This source file implements JSON handling utilities for parsing, reading, and saving JSON data, specifically targeting JSON structures related to feature lists and feature control. It includes functions for reading files, extracting array nodes from JSON, saving array contents to files, and traversing JSON structures to identify and save specific list data. The main function processes a JSON file provided as a command-line argument, extracts relevant data, and saves it to files based on environment variables.

methods.name: fsize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file in bytes by seeking to the end and using ftell.

methods.name: isNodeArrayType
methods.description: Checks if a cJSON node is of array type.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a dynamically allocated buffer.

methods.name: getArrayNode
methods.description: Recursively searches for and returns the first array-type node within a JSON structure.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves each string element of a JSON array node to a file, with filename formatted based on provided format and name.

methods.name: saveIfNodeContainsLists
methods.description: Checks if a JSON node contains a list (array) identified by 'listType' and saves it if present.

methods.name: iterateAndSaveArrayNodes
methods.description: Traverses the JSON structure to find feature list nodes and saves their array contents to files.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns a file path pattern based on environment variables or defaults.
